data.name: App_Cli_Help
data.value:
Lupe {0} – read QR codes and barcodes
Usage: {3} start the user interface {3} read <image> [<image> …] [--format <format>] {3} --background start in the notification area only (for autostart) {3} --screen scan a screen region right away (if Lupe is already running, it scans) – for a custom keyboard shortcut {3} --demo user interface with demo camera and sample history (saves nothing, no global keyboard shortcut) {3} --screenshots <folder> [--theme light|dark|both] {3} --help {3} --version version, for bug reports {3} --info version, licence, website, legal notice (Impressum), privacy and support German names work as well: lesen, --hintergrund, --bildschirm, --hilfe, --theme hell|dunkel|beide.
Screen scan: {1} (default, can be changed in the settings) reads a region of the screen – from any program, as long as Lupe is running.
"read" finds all codes in each image and writes one line per code: FORMAT<Tab>content e.g. QR_CODE<Tab>https://example.org Control characters in the content are escaped: \n (line break), \r, \t (tab), others as \xHH – such as \x1D, the separator in GS1 codes. Line and paragraph separators and characters that change the text direction come out as \uXXXX (e.g. \u2028, \u202E). Notes ("No code found") and errors go to stderr, so the output stays easy to process further.
{4} Wildcards are allowed in the file name, e.g. {5}.
Options for "read": --format <format> only look for these formats (repeat or separate with commas), e.g. --format QR_CODE,EAN_13 (also short: qr, ean13). Default: all. Formats: {2}
Exit codes: 0 at least one code found 1 no code found 3 error (image missing or unreadable, wrong usage, cancelled) – even if codes were found in other images
Examples: {3} read {7} {3} read {5} --format QR_CODE > codes.txt{6}
data.comment: {0} = version; {1} = default screen-scan shortcut; {2} = list of formats; {3} = command (Lupe.exe, lupe or the path in Lupe.app); {4} = App_Cli_Images* for this system; {5} = example path with wildcard; {6} = App_Cli_WindowsWait on Windows, else empty; {7} = App_Cli_ExampleFile. Command names and options (read, --format, --help …) and light|dark|both are keywords, do not translate. Both the English and the German keywords (lesen, --hilfe, hell|dunkel|beide) work in every language; the German text names the German ones.

data.value: Lupe.exe is a GUI program; to make the command prompt wait for it to finish: start /wait Lupe.exe read … (cmd, output in the console) Lupe.exe read … | Out-Default (PowerShell) With redirection (> codes.txt), call it without "start" – "start" does not pass the redirection on to Lupe, the file would stay empty.
